description: This Java source file defines the main activity class 'NewsReaderActivity' for an Android news reader application. The class manages the display of news headlines and articles, supporting both single-pane and dual-pane layouts, and handles interaction with the UI components such as fragments, action bar, and category selection.

classes.name: NewsReaderActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing news headlines and articles display, supporting dual-pane and single-pane layouts, and handling category and article selection.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, determines layout mode, sets up fragments, action bar, and listeners.

methods.name: restoreSelection
methods.description: Restores the current category and article selection from saved instance state.

methods.name: onRestoreInstanceState
methods.description: Called when the activity is restoring its state, delegates to restoreSelection.

methods.name: setUpActionBar
methods.description: Configures the action bar with tabs or list navigation depending on the device capabilities.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Sets the initial news category to display when activity starts.

methods.name: setNewsCategory
methods.description: Updates the displayed news category, headlines, and associated UI components.

methods.name: onHeadlineSelected
methods.description: Handles user selection of a news headline, displaying the article on dual-pane or launching a new activity.

methods.name: onCategorySelected
methods.description: Handles selection of a news category from the action bar, updating the display accordingly.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events on the category button, presenting a dialog for category selection.
